_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Logistics Plan
summary: The Logistics Plan provides the Government with details on the contractor's plans for Operation and Maintenance of a specific system to help assess its long-term affordability.
use_relationship:
The Logistics Plan provides the Government with details on the contractor's plans for Operation and Maintenance (O&M) of a specific system. This plan will help the government assess the long-term affordability of the system.

This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Logistics Plan shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Logistics Plan shall contain the basis for estimating the O&M impact of introducing a new capability on the range. The Logistics Plan shall include the following sections:

children.title: Maintenance Planning
children.content: This section shall include information for the following:

children.title: Level of repair for equipment (i.e., component, card, box replacement, etc.)
Requirements for preventive maintenance
Type, description, and amount of recommended spares
Maintenance and support agreement recommendations and associated costs
Support and Test Equipment
children.content: This section shall identify the recommended test equipment, specialized tools, and system-specific support equipment.

children.title: Operations and Maintenance Documentation
children.content: This section shall identify the following:

children.title: New documentation that is recommended for operating and maintaining the system
Recommended Procedures and Work Instructions for the system
Any external documents (e.g., Range User's Manual) that shall be updated
Manpower, Personnel, and Training
children.content: This section shall identify the following:

children.title: Required staffing to operate the system, including quantity, type of personnel, and work center
The maintenance tasks and who shall perform the maintenance, including quantity, type of personnel, and work center
Internal and external training recommendations and identification of personnel that require the training
Computer Resources Support
children.content: This section shall identify the following:

children.title: A description of required ongoing Information Assurance responsibilities for the system, and identify personnel that shall handle them
Any impact to administrative computing requirements
Facilities
children.content: Any possible impact to facilities (such as space, power, HVAC, security, etc.) shall be specified in this section.

children.title: Transportation and Storage
children.content: The information contained in this section shall identify:

children.title: Any special transportation required for equipment or personnel (e.g., helicopter, heavy equipment, etc.)
Special storage space that is needed
Ongoing Support
children.content: The information contained in this section shall identify other elements related to ongoing support of the system as appropriate.
